# GMP Construction

> GMP Construction is a general contractor established in 2019 and based in Cainta, Rizal, Philippines. The company handles residential construction, renovation, roofing, waterproofing, electrical and plumbing works, and specialist construction projects.

The canonical website is https://gmpconstruction.site/. Use the pages below for company information and the documented project portfolio.

## Company and services

- [Homepage](https://gmpconstruction.site/): Company introduction and featured projects.
- [Services](https://gmpconstruction.site/services.html): Construction, site development, roofing, waterproofing, interiors, finishes, electrical and plumbing.
- [About](https://gmpconstruction.site/about.html): Company background, mission, vision, values, and leadership.

## Project and contact information

- [Projects](https://gmpconstruction.site/projects.html): Documented residential, institutional, interior and specialist projects.
- [Contact](https://gmpconstruction.site/contact.html): Public contact details and office information.
- [Quotes and consultation](https://gmpconstruction.site/quote.html): Quote request and consultation information. The online forms and booking are currently previews.

- [Sitemap](https://gmpconstruction.site/sitemap.xml): Canonical page URLs.
